'''House Mandragoran''' is the restored royal house of [[Malkier]].{{ref/book|14|Epilogue}}
==House members==
* [[Lan Mandragoran|al'Lan Mandragoran]], the High Seat of House Mandragoran and King of Malkier.
** [[Nynaeve al'Meara|el'Nynaeve ti al'Meara Mandragoran]], the Queen of Malkier and an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Yellow Ajah]].
* [[al'Akir Mandragoran]], once High Seat of House Mandragoran and King of Malkier (deceased), father of al'Lan Mandragoran.
** [[el'Leanna Mandragoran|el'Leanna ti Arathdar Mandragoran]], Queen of Malkier (deceased), mother of al'Lan Mandragoran.
* Lord [[Lain Mandragoran]], younger brother of al'Akir Mandragoran, killed in the [[Blight]] (deceased).
** Lady [[Breyan Mandragoran|Breyan ti Maclain Mandragoran]], wife of Lord Lain. Plotted to take the throne of Malkier for her son. Vanished in a Trolloc attack.
*** Lord [[Isam Mandragoran]], son of Lord Lain and Lady Breyan. Merged with Lord [[Luc Mantear]] to become [[Slayer]].
